codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly addresses all three VAL-APP assertions. Mesh creation helpers were verified as already public on VulkanRenderer (VAL-APP-004). A Spawner extension trait on World provides entity creation without Application access (VAL-APP-005). spawn_gltf_model was converted from Option to AppResult with descriptive error variants (VAL-APP-006). Code quality is high: proper error handling, no unwrap in production code, pub(crate) visibility for the module, good test coverage, and all callers updated correctly.

issues.description: Spawner trait methods take position as [f32; 3] while the rest of the codebase (e.g., spawn_gltf_model) also uses [f32; 3]. This is consistent. However, the Spawner trait does not handle the sRGB→linear color conversion noted in katla_app/AGENTS.md ('Colors in spawning functions are sRGB, converted to linear internally'). The DrawableComponent::with_handles_and_color method should handle this, but it's worth verifying the color path is correct.

The discovered issue about GltfCache loader panicking on file-not-found is correctly noted as non-blocking and pre-existing. However, the feature description mentions 'file not found, parse error, GPU upload failure' as desired error variants. Only ShaderCompileFailed and SkeletonCreateFailed were added. The file-not-found and parse error cases cannot be properly handled without refactoring GltfCache/FileCache. This is a reasonable scope limitation given the pre-existing design constraint.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The Spawner trait pattern (extension trait on World for entity creation with standard component bundles) is a new architectural pattern that should be documented in .factory/library/architecture.md. Currently architecture.md documents ECS query/change detection, GPU resource cleanup, and scene serialization patterns but not the Spawner pattern.

The spawn_gltf_model Result conversion established a pattern for AppError variants: path + reason string pairs for operation-specific errors. The existing ModelLoadFailed and MaterialLoadFailed follow the same pattern. This is already implicit in error.rs but worth noting as a convention.

The app-worker SKILL.md lists specific file paths for scene and editor features but does not mention katla_app/src/spawner.rs or katla_app/src/error.rs as key files. Since the worker needed to modify both, the skill file could be updated for future spawning/API features.

summary: Clean implementation of all three VAL-APP assertions. The Spawner trait is well-designed with proper documentation, 4 unit tests, and good API ergonomics. The spawn_gltf_model Result conversion correctly uses descriptive error variants and updates all callers. No unwrap calls in production code, proper pub(crate) module visibility, dependency boundaries respected. Two non-blocking suggestions: verify sRGB color handling path in Spawner, and note that file-not-found/parse error variants were scoped out due to GltfCache design constraints.
